articles.title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
articles.description:
“This game exemplifies who we are now. There was never any doubt.”

The post 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox secured their 8th consecutive victory against the White Sox on August 7.
The team overcame 5 deficits, showcasing resilience and determination throughout the 13-inning game.
This win boosts local morale and strengthens the team's playoff hopes for Boston fans.
